title: Data entry job at a Liguanea firm
body: DataProc Solutions on Constant Spring Road. Five-day week, $280 a month. Entry-level data entry — clean office, 8 to 5. It's not what you planned but it covers rent with $80 left over. They want an answer by Friday.

choices.label: Decline. Hustle pays more if you're smart.

title: Halima's tip about the Thursday market
body: Halima calls. She says the Thursday night market at Sovereign Centre car park is underserved — people want phone accessories and screen repairs. 'The people with steady money are the ones who fix things,' she says.

choices.label: Go check the market this Thursday.
Note it but stick to your current work.

title: Your supervisor cut your hours
body: Courtney from DataProc calls. He's cutting you to 3 days a week starting next month because 'hours are being restructured.' You know it's because you pushed back on a process last Tuesday that wasn't your job. You can accept, escalate, or leave.

choices.label: Go over Courtney's head to management.
Quit and go full-time on your own work.

title: PinkStar Logistics needs riders this weekend
body: PinkStar Logistics texts a blast to their list. Event delivery this weekend — Friday to Sunday, 3 PM to 10 PM. $15 an hour, cash same night. Need your own bike and ID. First come first served. Twelve spots.

choices.label: Sign up for all three days.
Skip it. Too much time away from your own work.
